agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Clinical bureaucratic attire for a world of licensed gravity. Outfits feature heavy ceramic ballast, brass calibration hardware, and vermilion cords to maintain orientation in shifting vector zones.

visual_consistency_rules: Vermilion lines must be perfectly vertical
Brass elements must have 1-pixel specular glints
No organic curves; use 45/90 degree angles
